description: Tablero operativo de desvíos sobre ABT0. Arriba, la vista NOC: hasta qué minuto hay dato, estado vs lo habitual (D-7 · D-14 · D-21, logica de las alertas), volumen total, latencia y estado por gateway.

panels.title: NOC · ¿Está procesando? · frescura del dato, volumen total y latencia

panels.description: Último minuto que se está mirando, en hora Argentina. Como en las alertas, es el último minuto cargado en ABT0 menos 15' de asentamiento (los últimos minutos que carga el ETL llegan incompletos), o el fin del rango si el rango termina antes. Todos los gráficos NOC terminan acá.
panels.title: Datos hasta

targets.rawSQL:
-- KPIs NOC: estado del segmento filtrado con la logica de las alertas (logica_desvios.py).
-- Ventana de estado = los ultimos $ventana minutos cerrados (bloques de 5') hasta el ancla,
-- contra la mediana de la misma franja en D-7 · D-14 · D-21 sin feriados.
-- Una sola consulta alimenta los 8 indicadores (paneles 1000-1007).
WITH gm AS (SELECT CAST(MAX(minuto_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS m FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring WHERE fecha_particion >= date_format(date_add('day',-1,current_date),'%Y-%m-%d')),
lim AS (SELECT g.m AS gm, CASE WHEN g.m >= date_trunc('minute', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)) - INTERVAL '60' MINUTE THEN LEAST(date_trunc('minute', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)), date_trunc('minute', g.m) + INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE) ELSE date_trunc('minute', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)) - INTERVAL '60' MINUTE END AS m, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(NULLIF('${ventana:raw}','') AS INTEGER), 5) AS vent FROM gm g),
lim2 AS (SELECT gm, m, vent, m - (EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM m) % 5) * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE AS fin FROM lim),
b AS (SELECT CAST(a.minuto_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS ts, TRIM(a.cod_respuesta) AS cr, TRIM(a.cod_tipo_mensaje) AS cmsg, NULLIF(TRIM(a.nrorechazointerno),'') AS nri, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'PN' THEN 'NARANJA' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('PB','PC','PM','PP') THEN 'PRIVADAS' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.marca),''), 'OTRAS') END AS marca_f, TRIM(a.codbancoemisor) AS cbe_f, CASE WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))=1 THEN '0'||TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss) WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))>=2 THEN substr(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))-1,2) ELSE NULL END AS ciss_norm, IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4, substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4), TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) AS gw, a.latencia_ms AS lat FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(e.cod_debito_automatico_estab,'')) = '1') dafil ON dafil.nro_establecimiento = TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento) AS INTEGER) WHERE (a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour',-7,$__timeTo())),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeTo()),'%Y-%m-%d') OR a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -168, date_add('hour',-2,$__timeTo()))),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -168, $__timeTo())),'%Y-%m-%d') OR a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -336, date_add('hour',-2,$__timeTo()))),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -336, $__timeTo())),'%Y-%m-%d') OR a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -504, date_add('hour',-2,$__timeTo()))),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -504, $__timeTo())),'%Y-%m-%d')) AND ((a.minuto_utc >= date_add('hour',-7,$__timeTo()) AND a.minuto_utc < $__timeTo()) OR (a.minuto_utc >= date_add('hour', -168, date_add('hour',-2,$__timeTo())) AND a.minuto_utc < date_add('hour', -168, $__timeTo())) OR (a.minuto_utc >= date_add('hour', -336, date_add('hour',-2,$__timeTo())) AND a.minuto_utc < date_add('hour', -336, $__timeTo())) OR (a.minuto_utc >= date_add('hour', -504, date_add('hour',-2,$__timeTo())) AND a.minuto_utc < date_add('hour', -504, $__timeTo()))) AND TRIM(a.cod_proceso_autorizacion) NOT IN('92','30') AND (COALESCE(NULLIF('${cuit:raw}',''),'-1')='-1' OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT)=TRY_CAST(REPLACE('${cuit:raw}','-','') AS BIGINT)) AND ('${establecimiento:raw}'='' OR TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento)='${establecimiento:raw}')
    AND (TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) NOT IN (30712334610,30715313681,30717791904,30718438906,30716325586,30691399768,33714595569,30709228419))
    -- FILTRO Tipo de producto
    AND ( '${producto:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('VD','MD','MS') THEN 'Débito' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('V6','VB','VN','VC','MC','AX','PA') THEN 'Crédito' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('VK','SR','MK') THEN 'Prepaga' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('PB','PC','PM','PP') THEN 'Marcas Privadas' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'PN' THEN 'Naranja Pura' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'UC' THEN 'Indeterminado (Créd/Déb)' ELSE 'Otro' END) = '${producto:raw}' )
    -- FILTRO Plataforma de pago (la variable trae el sufijo de 4 digitos)
    AND ( '${plataforma:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR contains(split('${plataforma:raw}', ','),
                      IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4,
                         substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4),
                         TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,'')))) )
    -- FILTRO Modalidad
    AND ( '${modalidad:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.coddebitoautomatico,'')) = '1'
                     OR ( dafil.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL
                          AND TRIM(COALESCE(a.codmetodoingresomovimiento,'')) IN ('0','1') )
                        THEN 'Débito Automático'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) = '8'
                        THEN 'E-commerce'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) <> ''
                        THEN 'Presente'
                   ELSE 'Indeterminado'
              END) = '${modalidad:raw}' )),
filt AS (SELECT * FROM b WHERE 1=1 AND ('${marca:text}'='All' OR marca_f IN (${marca:sqlstring})) AND ('${banco:text}'='All' OR cbe_f IN (${banco:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_emisor:text}'='All' OR ciss_norm IN (${motivo_emisor:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_adqte:text}'='All' OR nri IN (${motivo_adqte:sqlstring}))),
agg AS (SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '0' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '0' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS act_t,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '0' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '0' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' AND cr IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS act_a,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '0' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '0' HOUR AND cmsg='1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS act_r,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '0' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '0' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS act30,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '0' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '0' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS act_n,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r1_t,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' AND cr IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r1_a,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND cmsg='1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r1_r,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r1_30,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r1_n,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r2_t,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' AND cr IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r2_a,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND cmsg='1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r2_r,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r2_30,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r2_n,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r3_t,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' AND cr IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r3_a,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND cmsg='1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r3_r,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r3_30,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r3_n
  FROM filt CROSS JOIN lim2 l),
src AS (SELECT l.vent, a.act_t, a.act_a, a.act_r, a.act30, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r1_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r1_t END AS r1_t, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r1_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r1_a END AS r1_a, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r1_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r1_r END AS r1_r, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r1_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r1_30 END AS r1_30, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r2_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r2_t END AS r2_t, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r2_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r2_a END AS r2_a, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r2_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r2_r END AS r2_r, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r2_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r2_30 END AS r2_30, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r3_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r3_t END AS r3_t, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r3_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r3_a END AS r3_a, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r3_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r3_r END AS r3_r, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r3_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r3_30 END AS r3_30 FROM agg a CROSS JOIN lim2 l),
ez1 AS (SELECT s.*, s.act_t - s.act_a AS act_d,
    array_sort(filter(ARRAY[s.r1_t, s.r2_t, s.r3_t], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar_t,
    array_sort(filter(ARRAY[s.r1_t - s.r1_a, s.r2_t - s.r2_a, s.r3_t - s.r3_a], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar_d,
    array_sort(filter(ARRAY[s.r1_r, s.r2_r, s.r3_r], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar_r,
    array_sort(filter(ARRAY[IF(s.r1_t > 0, 100.0 * s.r1_a / s.r1_t), IF(s.r2_t > 0, 100.0 * s.r2_a / s.r2_t), IF(s.r3_t > 0, 100.0 * s.r3_a / s.r3_t)], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar_taa,
    array_sort(filter(ARRAY[s.r1_30, s.r2_30, s.r3_30], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar_30,
    2 * s.vent AS min_exc, s.vent AS min_rev
  FROM src s),
ez2 AS (SELECT ez1.*, (CASE cardinality(ar_t) WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN element_at(ar_t, 1) WHEN 2 THEN (element_at(ar_t, 1) + element_at(ar_t, 2)) / 2.0 ELSE element_at(ar_t, 2) END) AS esp_t, (CASE cardinality(ar_d) WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN element_at(ar_d, 1) WHEN 2 THEN (element_at(ar_d, 1) + element_at(ar_d, 2)) / 2.0 ELSE element_at(ar_d, 2) END) AS esp_d, (CASE cardinality(ar_r) WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN element_at(ar_r, 1) WHEN 2 THEN (element_at(ar_r, 1) + element_at(ar_r, 2)) / 2.0 ELSE element_at(ar_r, 2) END) AS esp_r,
    (CASE cardinality(ar_taa) WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN element_at(ar_taa, 1) WHEN 2 THEN (element_at(ar_taa, 1) + element_at(ar_taa, 2)) / 2.0 ELSE element_at(ar_taa, 2) END) AS taa_esp, (CASE cardinality(ar_30) WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN element_at(ar_30, 1) WHEN 2 THEN (element_at(ar_30, 1) + element_at(ar_30, 2)) / 2.0 ELSE element_at(ar_30, 2) END) AS esp_30, cardinality(ar_t) AS n_ref,
    IF(act_t > 0, 100.0 * act_a / act_t) AS taa_act
  FROM ez1),
ez3 AS (SELECT ez2.*,
    IF(esp_t > 0, 100.0 * act_t / esp_t - 100) AS dvol,
    taa_act - taa_esp AS dtaa,
    IF(esp_t > 0, (act_t - esp_t) / sqrt(esp_t)) AS z_vol,
    IF(taa_act IS NOT NULL AND taa_esp IS NOT NULL AND act_t > 0,
       ((taa_act - taa_esp) / 100) / sqrt(LEAST(GREATEST(taa_esp / 100, 0.005), 0.995) * (1 - LEAST(GREATEST(taa_esp / 100, 0.005), 0.995)) / act_t)) AS z_taa,
    act_d - act_t * (1 - taa_esp / 100) AS exc_t,
    act_d - esp_d AS exc_d, act_d / GREATEST(esp_d, 1) AS x_d, (act_d - esp_d) / sqrt(2 * GREATEST(esp_d, 1)) AS z_d,
    act_r - esp_r AS exc_r, act_r / GREATEST(esp_r, 1) AS x_r, (act_r - esp_r) / sqrt(2 * GREATEST(esp_r, 1)) AS z_r
  FROM ez2),
ez4 AS (SELECT ez3.*,
    (z_vol IS NULL OR z_vol <= -2) AS sig_baja,
    (z_taa IS NULL OR z_taa <= -2) AS sig_taa,
    (z_vol IS NULL OR z_vol >= 2) AS sig_suba,
    COALESCE(exc_d >= min_exc AND z_d >= 3, false) AS den_real,
    COALESCE(exc_r >= min_rev AND z_r >= 3, false) AS rev_real
  FROM ez3),
ez5 AS (SELECT ez4.*,
    COALESCE(dvol <= -60 AND sig_baja, false) AS bv1, COALESCE(dvol <= -30 AND sig_baja, false) AS bv0,
    COALESCE(dtaa <= -4 AND sig_taa AND exc_t >= min_exc, false) AS bt1,
    COALESCE(dtaa <= -1.5 AND sig_taa AND exc_t >= min_exc, false) AS bt0,
    COALESCE(den_real AND x_d >= 4, false) AS bd1, COALESCE(den_real AND x_d >= 2, false) AS bd0,
    COALESCE(rev_real AND x_r >= 6, false) AS br1, COALESCE(rev_real AND x_r >= 3, false) AS br0
  FROM ez4),
ez6 AS (SELECT ez5.*,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(esp_t < 50, true) AND act_t < 50 THEN 'nd'
         WHEN esp_t IS NULL OR esp_t = 0 THEN IF(act_t >= 50, 'info', 'nd')
         WHEN bv1 OR bt1 OR bd1 OR br1 THEN 'crit'
         WHEN bv0 OR bt0 OR bd0 OR br0 THEN 'warn'
         WHEN dvol >= 30 AND sig_suba THEN 'info'
         ELSE 'ok' END AS st0
  FROM ez5),
ez7 AS (SELECT ez6.*,
    -- un segmento chico que deja de operar: se mira en 30'
    COALESCE(st0 = 'nd' AND esp_30 >= 8
             AND (act30 = 0 OR (act30 <= esp_30 / 3 AND (act30 - esp_30) / sqrt(esp_30) <= -3)), false) AS chica,
    IF(st0 = 'crit', bv1, bv0) AS ej_v, IF(st0 = 'crit', bt1 OR bd1, bt0 OR bd0) AS ej_r, IF(st0 = 'crit', br1, br0) AS ej_rv
  FROM ez6),
ez8 AS (SELECT ez7.*,
    CASE WHEN chica THEN IF(act30 = 0, 'crit', 'warn') ELSE st0 END AS st,
    CASE WHEN chica THEN 'volumen'
         WHEN st0 NOT IN ('crit', 'warn') THEN NULL
         WHEN ej_v AND NOT ej_r THEN 'volumen'
         WHEN ej_r AND NOT ej_v THEN 'rechazo'
         WHEN ej_v AND ej_r THEN IF(dvol <= -60, 'volumen', 'rechazo')
         WHEN ej_rv THEN 'reversos'
         ELSE 'rechazo' END AS causa,
    IF(chica, 100.0 * act30 / esp_30 - 100, dvol) AS dvol_v
  FROM ez7),
est AS (SELECT ez8.*,
    CASE WHEN st IN ('nd', 'ok', 'info') THEN st
         WHEN causa = 'rechazo' THEN 'rech' WHEN causa = 'reversos' THEN 'rev'
         WHEN (chica AND act30 = 0) OR (NOT chica AND act_t = 0) THEN 'cero' ELSE 'vol' END AS tipo,
    CASE WHEN st = 'nd' AND NOT chica THEN 'nd' WHEN chica THEN st WHEN bv1 THEN 'crit' WHEN bv0 THEN 'warn'
         WHEN COALESCE(esp_t > 0 AND dvol >= 30 AND sig_suba, false) OR ((esp_t IS NULL OR esp_t = 0) AND act_t >= 50) THEN 'info'
         ELSE 'ok' END AS sev_vol,
    CASE WHEN st = 'nd' THEN 'nd' WHEN bt1 THEN 'crit' WHEN bt0 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END AS sev_taa,
    CASE WHEN st = 'nd' THEN 'nd' WHEN bd1 THEN 'crit' WHEN bd0 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END AS sev_den,
    CASE WHEN st = 'nd' THEN 'nd' WHEN br1 THEN 'crit' WHEN br0 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END AS sev_rev
  FROM ez8)
SELECT
  date_format(l.m - INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%d/%m %H:%i') || ' hs' AS ultimo_minuto,
  date_diff('minute', l.gm, CAST(current_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp)) AS atraso_min,
  CAST((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END) AS varchar) || ' min' AS resolucion,
  date_format(l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%H:%i') || '–' || date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%H:%i') AS ventana_txt,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.gm < date_trunc('minute', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)) - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE, true) THEN 'W|⏱ Dato atrasado' ELSE ((CASE e.st WHEN 'crit' THEN 'C' WHEN 'warn' THEN 'W' WHEN 'info' THEN 'I' WHEN 'ok' THEN 'N' WHEN 'nd' THEN 'D' ELSE 'D' END) || '|' || (CASE e.tipo WHEN 'rech' THEN '✖ Más rechazos' WHEN 'rev' THEN '↺ Más reversos' WHEN 'vol' THEN '▼ Menos tráfico' WHEN 'cero' THEN '▼ Sin tráfico' WHEN 'info' THEN '▲ Más tráfico' WHEN 'ok' THEN '✔ En banda' WHEN 'nd' THEN '○ Sin evaluar' END)) END AS estado_txt,
  ((CASE e.sev_vol WHEN 'crit' THEN 'C' WHEN 'warn' THEN 'W' WHEN 'info' THEN 'I' WHEN 'ok' THEN 'N' WHEN 'nd' THEN 'D' ELSE 'D' END) || '|' || replace(CAST(CAST(ROUND(1.0 * e.act_t / e.vent, 1) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS VARCHAR), '.', ',') || '/min · ' || COALESCE((CASE WHEN e.dvol_v > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || replace(CAST(CAST(ROUND(e.dvol_v, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,0)) AS VARCHAR), '.', ',')) || '%', IF(e.act_t > 0, 'nuevo', 's/b'))) AS vol_txt,
  ((CASE e.sev_taa WHEN 'crit' THEN 'C' WHEN 'warn' THEN 'W' WHEN 'info' THEN 'I' WHEN 'ok' THEN 'N' WHEN 'nd' THEN 'D' ELSE 'D' END) || '|' || COALESCE(replace(CAST(CAST(ROUND(e.taa_act, 1) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS VARCHAR), '.', ',') || '%', '—') || ' · ' || COALESCE((CASE WHEN e.dtaa > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || replace(CAST(CAST(ROUND(e.dtaa, 1) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS VARCHAR), '.', ',')) || 'pp', 's/b')) AS taa_txt,
  ((CASE e.sev_den WHEN 'crit' THEN 'C' WHEN 'warn' THEN 'W' WHEN 'info' THEN 'I' WHEN 'ok' THEN 'N' WHEN 'nd' THEN 'D' ELSE 'D' END) || '|' || replace(CAST(CAST(ROUND(1.0 * e.act_d / e.vent, 1) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS VARCHAR), '.', ',') || '/min · ' || COALESCE('×' || replace(CAST(CAST(ROUND(e.x_d, 1) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS VARCHAR), '.', ','), 's/b')) AS den_txt,
  ((CASE e.sev_rev WHEN 'crit' THEN 'C' WHEN 'warn' THEN 'W' WHEN 'info' THEN 'I' WHEN 'ok' THEN 'N' WHEN 'nd' THEN 'D' ELSE 'D' END) || '|' || replace(CAST(CAST(ROUND(1.0 * e.act_r / e.vent, 1) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS VARCHAR), '.', ',') || '/min · ' || COALESCE('×' || replace(CAST(CAST(ROUND(e.x_r, 1) AS DECIMAL(18,1)) AS VARCHAR), '.', ','), 's/b')) AS rev_txt,
  e.st, e.causa, e.tipo, e.vent, e.n_ref, e.act_t, e.act_d, e.act_r,
  ROUND(e.esp_t, 1) AS esp_t, ROUND(e.dvol_v, 1) AS dvol, ROUND(e.z_vol, 2) AS z_vol,
  ROUND(e.taa_act, 2) AS taa_act, ROUND(e.taa_esp, 2) AS taa_esp, ROUND(e.dtaa, 2) AS dtaa, ROUND(e.z_taa, 2) AS z_taa,
  ROUND(e.x_d, 2) AS x_d, ROUND(e.z_d, 2) AS z_d, ROUND(e.x_r, 2) AS x_r, ROUND(e.z_r, 2) AS z_r
FROM est e CROSS JOIN lim2 l

panels.description: Minutos entre ahora y el último minuto cargado en ABT0, sin filtros. A partir de 30' el estado dice «Dato atrasado»: la falta de tráfico puede ser la ABT, no una caída.
panels.title: Atraso

panels.description: Tamaño de bucket de los gráficos (variable Resolución; en 'auto' depende del largo del rango). Durante un incidente conviene 1 min.
panels.title: Resolución

panels.description: Estado del segmento filtrado con las reglas de las alertas: crítico o atención si cae el volumen (−30 % / −60 %), cae la aceptación (−1.5 / −4 pp), suben las denegadas (×2 / ×4) o los reversos (×3 / ×6), y además la diferencia es significativa (z). Con menos de 50 tx en la ventana no se evalúa, salvo que un segmento chico deje de operar en 30'. ventana de estado = los últimos $ventana minutos cerrados (bloques de 5') hasta «Datos hasta», contra la mediana de la misma franja en D-7 · D-14 · D-21 (sin feriados). Misma lógica que las alertas.
panels.title: Estado

panels.description: TRX por minuto en la ventana y diferencia contra lo habitual. Se pinta si cae 30 % o más y la caída es significativa (z ≤ −2, Poisson). ventana de estado = los últimos $ventana minutos cerrados (bloques de 5') hasta «Datos hasta», contra la mediana de la misma franja en D-7 · D-14 · D-21 (sin feriados). Misma lógica que las alertas.
panels.title: Volumen

panels.description: Tasa de aceptación de la ventana y diferencia en pp contra la habitual. Se pinta si cae 1.5 pp o más, es significativa (z ≤ −2, binomial) y explica al menos 2 rechazos de más por minuto. ventana de estado = los últimos $ventana minutos cerrados (bloques de 5') hasta «Datos hasta», contra la mediana de la misma franja en D-7 · D-14 · D-21 (sin feriados). Misma lógica que las alertas.
panels.title: Aceptación

panels.description: Denegadas por minuto y cuántas veces lo habitual. Se pinta desde ×2 si el exceso es de al menos 2 por minuto y z ≥ 3. ventana de estado = los últimos $ventana minutos cerrados (bloques de 5') hasta «Datos hasta», contra la mediana de la misma franja en D-7 · D-14 · D-21 (sin feriados). Misma lógica que las alertas.
panels.title: Denegadas

panels.description: Reversos (1420) por minuto y cuántas veces lo habitual: respuestas que no llegan a tiempo. Se pinta desde ×3 si el exceso es de al menos 1 por minuto y z ≥ 3. ventana de estado = los últimos $ventana minutos cerrados (bloques de 5') hasta «Datos hasta», contra la mediana de la misma franja en D-7 · D-14 · D-21 (sin feriados). Misma lógica que las alertas.
panels.title: Reversos

panels.description: Todo en transacciones por minuto, así cambiar la resolución no cambia la escala y el último bucket parcial no dibuja una caída falsa. Los buckets sin tráfico valen 0. Habitual = mediana del mismo bucket en D-7 · D-14 · D-21 sin feriados; la banda gris va del mínimo al máximo de esos días. Total excluye reversos (1420) y procesos 92/30.

targets.rawSQL:
-- Procesamiento en TRX por minuto: actual contra lo habitual (mediana de D-7 · D-14 · D-21
-- sin feriados) y su rango (minimo y maximo de esos dias). Tambien devuelve % vs habitual
-- y latencia, que usan los paneles 1011 y 1012.
WITH gm AS (SELECT CAST(MAX(minuto_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS m FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring WHERE fecha_particion >= date_format(date_add('day',-1,current_date),'%Y-%m-%d')),
lim AS (SELECT date_trunc('minute',CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp)) AS t0, (SELECT CASE WHEN g.m >= date_trunc('minute', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)) - INTERVAL '60' MINUTE THEN LEAST(date_trunc('minute', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)), date_trunc('minute', g.m) + INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '15' MINUTE) ELSE date_trunc('minute', CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)) - INTERVAL '60' MINUTE END FROM gm g) AS t1),
b AS (SELECT CAST(a.minuto_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS timestamp) AS ts, TRIM(a.cod_respuesta) AS cr, TRIM(a.cod_tipo_mensaje) AS cmsg, NULLIF(TRIM(a.nrorechazointerno),'') AS nri, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'PN' THEN 'NARANJA' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('PB','PC','PM','PP') THEN 'PRIVADAS' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.marca),''), 'OTRAS') END AS marca_f, TRIM(a.codbancoemisor) AS cbe_f, CASE WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))=1 THEN '0'||TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss) WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))>=2 THEN substr(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))-1,2) ELSE NULL END AS ciss_norm, IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4, substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4), TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) AS gw, a.latencia_ms AS lat FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(e.cod_debito_automatico_estab,'')) = '1') dafil ON dafil.nro_establecimiento = TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento) AS INTEGER) WHERE (a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeFrom()),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeTo()),'%Y-%m-%d') OR a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -168, $__timeFrom())),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -168, $__timeTo())),'%Y-%m-%d') OR a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -336, $__timeFrom())),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -336, $__timeTo())),'%Y-%m-%d') OR a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -504, $__timeFrom())),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,date_add('hour', -504, $__timeTo())),'%Y-%m-%d')) AND ((a.minuto_utc >= $__timeFrom() AND a.minuto_utc < $__timeTo()) OR (a.minuto_utc >= date_add('hour', -168, $__timeFrom()) AND a.minuto_utc < date_add('hour', -168, $__timeTo())) OR (a.minuto_utc >= date_add('hour', -336, $__timeFrom()) AND a.minuto_utc < date_add('hour', -336, $__timeTo())) OR (a.minuto_utc >= date_add('hour', -504, $__timeFrom()) AND a.minuto_utc < date_add('hour', -504, $__timeTo()))) AND TRIM(a.cod_proceso_autorizacion) NOT IN('92','30') AND (COALESCE(NULLIF('${cuit:raw}',''),'-1')='-1' OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT)=TRY_CAST(REPLACE('${cuit:raw}','-','') AS BIGINT)) AND ('${establecimiento:raw}'='' OR TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento)='${establecimiento:raw}')
    AND (TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) NOT IN (30712334610,30715313681,30717791904,30718438906,30716325586,30691399768,33714595569,30709228419))
    -- FILTRO Tipo de producto
    AND ( '${producto:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('VD','MD','MS') THEN 'Débito' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('V6','VB','VN','VC','MC','AX','PA') THEN 'Crédito' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('VK','SR','MK') THEN 'Prepaga' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('PB','PC','PM','PP') THEN 'Marcas Privadas' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'PN' THEN 'Naranja Pura' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'UC' THEN 'Indeterminado (Créd/Déb)' ELSE 'Otro' END) = '${producto:raw}' )
    -- FILTRO Plataforma de pago (la variable trae el sufijo de 4 digitos)
    AND ( '${plataforma:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR contains(split('${plataforma:raw}', ','),
                      IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4,
                         substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4),
                         TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,'')))) )
    -- FILTRO Modalidad
    AND ( '${modalidad:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.coddebitoautomatico,'')) = '1'
                     OR ( dafil.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL
                          AND TRIM(COALESCE(a.codmetodoingresomovimiento,'')) IN ('0','1') )
                        THEN 'Débito Automático'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) = '8'
                        THEN 'E-commerce'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) <> ''
                        THEN 'Presente'
                   ELSE 'Indeterminado'
              END) = '${modalidad:raw}' )),
filt AS (SELECT * FROM b WHERE 1=1 AND ('${marca:text}'='All' OR marca_f IN (${marca:sqlstring})) AND ('${banco:text}'='All' OR cbe_f IN (${banco:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_emisor:text}'='All' OR ciss_norm IN (${motivo_emisor:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_adqte:text}'='All' OR nri IN (${motivo_adqte:sqlstring}))),
x AS (SELECT ep, ts + ep * INTERVAL '1' HOUR AS tsa, cr, cmsg, lat FROM (
  SELECT f.*, CASE WHEN ts >= l.t0 AND ts < l.t1 THEN 0 WHEN ts >= date_add('hour', -168, l.t0) AND ts < date_add('hour', -168, l.t1) THEN 168 WHEN ts >= date_add('hour', -336, l.t0) AND ts < date_add('hour', -336, l.t1) THEN 336 WHEN ts >= date_add('hour', -504, l.t0) AND ts < date_add('hour', -504, l.t1) THEN 504 END AS ep FROM filt f CROSS JOIN lim l) WHERE ep IS NOT NULL),
agg AS (SELECT date_trunc('minute',tsa)-(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM tsa)%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE AS time, ep,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cmsg<>'1420' AND cr IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aprob,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cmsg<>'1420' AND cr NOT IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deneg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cmsg='1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rev,
  approx_percentile(CASE WHEN cmsg<>'1420' AND lat >= 0 THEN CAST(lat AS double) END, 0.95) AS p95,
  approx_percentile(CASE WHEN cmsg<>'1420' AND lat >= 0 THEN CAST(lat AS double) END, 0.50) AS p50
  FROM x GROUP BY 1, 2),
hay AS (SELECT DISTINCT ep FROM agg),
grid AS (SELECT g AS time FROM lim CROSS JOIN UNNEST(CASE WHEN lim.t1 > date_trunc('minute',GREATEST(lim.t0, lim.t1 - ((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))-(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM GREATEST(lim.t0, lim.t1 - ((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE THEN sequence(date_trunc('minute',GREATEST(lim.t0, lim.t1 - ((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))-(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM GREATEST(lim.t0, lim.t1 - ((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, lim.t1 - INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, (CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE) ELSE CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(timestamp)) END) AS t(g)),
piv AS (SELECT g.time, date_diff('minute', GREATEST(g.time, l.t0), LEAST(g.time + (CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, l.t1)) AS mins,
  COALESCE(a.total,0) AS total, COALESCE(a.aprob,0) AS aprob, COALESCE(a.deneg,0) AS deneg,
  COALESCE(a.rev,0) AS rev, a.p95, a.p50,
  CASE WHEN (date_format(g.time - INTERVAL '168' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR h1.ep IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(r1.total, 0) END AS r1_total,
  CASE WHEN (date_format(g.time - INTERVAL '336' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR h2.ep IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(r2.total, 0) END AS r2_total,
  CASE WHEN (date_format(g.time - INTERVAL '504' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR h3.ep IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(r3.total, 0) END AS r3_total
  FROM grid g CROSS JOIN lim l
  LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.time = g.time AND a.ep = 0
  LEFT JOIN agg r1 ON r1.time = g.time AND r1.ep = 168
  LEFT JOIN hay h1 ON h1.ep = 168
  LEFT JOIN agg r2 ON r2.time = g.time AND r2.ep = 336
  LEFT JOIN hay h2 ON h2.ep = 336
  LEFT JOIN agg r3 ON r3.time = g.time AND r3.ep = 504
  LEFT JOIN hay h3 ON h3.ep = 504),
hab AS (SELECT piv.*, array_sort(filter(ARRAY[r1_total, r2_total, r3_total], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar FROM piv)

((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE THEN sequence(date_trunc('minute',GREATEST(lim.t0, lim.t1 - ((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))-(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM GREATEST(lim.t0, lim.t1 - ((CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*9999)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE))%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, lim.t1 - INTERVAL '1' MINUTE, (CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END)*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE) ELSE CAST(ARRAY[] AS array(timestamp)) END) AS t(g))
SELECT g.time, COALESCE(gm_.nombre, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.gw,'')='' THEN 'Sin plataforma' ELSE 'No mapeado' END) || ' (' || COALESCE(NULLIF(t.gw,''),'-') || ')' AS metric, t.gw AS cod,

  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND cmsg='1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r1_r,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r1_30,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '168' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r1_n,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r2_t,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' AND cr IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r2_a,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND cmsg='1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r2_r,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r2_30,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '336' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r2_n,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r3_t,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' AND cr IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r3_a,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - l.vent * INTERVAL '1' MINUTE - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND cmsg='1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r3_r,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r3_30,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= l.fin - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE - INTERVAL '504' HOUR AND ts < l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS r3_n,
  MAX(CASE WHEN ts >= l.m - INTERVAL '6' HOUR AND ts < l.m AND cmsg<>'1420' THEN ts END) AS lt
  FROM filt CROSS JOIN lim2 l GROUP BY gw),
src AS (SELECT a.gw, a.lt, l.vent, a.act_t, a.act_a, a.act_r, a.act30, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r1_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r1_t END AS r1_t, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r1_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r1_a END AS r1_a, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r1_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r1_r END AS r1_r, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '168' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r1_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r1_30 END AS r1_30, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r2_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r2_t END AS r2_t, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r2_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r2_a END AS r2_a, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r2_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r2_r END AS r2_r, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '336' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r2_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r2_30 END AS r2_30, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r3_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r3_t END AS r3_t, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r3_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r3_a END AS r3_a, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r3_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r3_r END AS r3_r, CASE WHEN (date_format(l.fin - INTERVAL '504' HOUR - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%Y-%m-%d') IN ('2026-08-17','2026-10-12','2026-11-23','2026-12-08','2026-12-25','2027-01-01','2027-02-08','2027-02-09','2027-03-24','2027-03-25','2027-03-26','2027-04-02','2027-05-01','2027-05-25','2027-06-20','2027-06-21','2027-07-09','2027-08-16','2027-10-11','2027-11-20','2027-12-08','2027-12-25')) OR a.r3_n = 0 THEN NULL ELSE a.r3_30 END AS r3_30 FROM agg a CROSS JOIN lim2 l),
ez1 AS (SELECT s.*, s.act_t - s.act_a AS act_d,
    array_sort(filter(ARRAY[s.r1_t, s.r2_t, s.r3_t], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar_t,
    array_sort(filter(ARRAY[s.r1_t - s.r1_a, s.r2_t - s.r2_a, s.r3_t - s.r3_a], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar_d,
    array_sort(filter(ARRAY[s.r1_r, s.r2_r, s.r3_r], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar_r,
    array_sort(filter(ARRAY[IF(s.r1_t > 0, 100.0 * s.r1_a / s.r1_t), IF(s.r2_t > 0, 100.0 * s.r2_a / s.r2_t), IF(s.r3_t > 0, 100.0 * s.r3_a / s.r3_t)], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar_taa,
    array_sort(filter(ARRAY[s.r1_30, s.r2_30, s.r3_30], v -> v IS NOT NULL)) AS ar_30,
    2 * s.vent AS min_exc, s.vent AS min_rev
  FROM src s),
ez2 AS (SELECT ez1.*, (CASE cardinality(ar_t) WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN element_at(ar_t, 1) WHEN 2 THEN (element_at(ar_t, 1) + element_at(ar_t, 2)) / 2.0 ELSE element_at(ar_t, 2) END) AS esp_t, (CASE cardinality(ar_d) WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN element_at(ar_d, 1) WHEN 2 THEN (element_at(ar_d, 1) + element_at(ar_d, 2)) / 2.0 ELSE element_at(ar_d, 2) END) AS esp_d, (CASE cardinality(ar_r) WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN element_at(ar_r, 1) WHEN 2 THEN (element_at(ar_r, 1) + element_at(ar_r, 2)) / 2.0 ELSE element_at(ar_r, 2) END) AS esp_r,
    (CASE cardinality(ar_taa) WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN element_at(ar_taa, 1) WHEN 2 THEN (element_at(ar_taa, 1) + element_at(ar_taa, 2)) / 2.0 ELSE element_at(ar_taa, 2) END) AS taa_esp, (CASE cardinality(ar_30) WHEN 0 THEN NULL WHEN 1 THEN element_at(ar_30, 1) WHEN 2 THEN (element_at(ar_30, 1) + element_at(ar_30, 2)) / 2.0 ELSE element_at(ar_30, 2) END) AS esp_30, cardinality(ar_t) AS n_ref,
    IF(act_t > 0, 100.0 * act_a / act_t) AS taa_act
  FROM ez1),
ez3 AS (SELECT ez2.*,
    IF(esp_t > 0, 100.0 * act_t / esp_t - 100) AS dvol,
    taa_act - taa_esp AS dtaa,
    IF(esp_t > 0, (act_t - esp_t) / sqrt(esp_t)) AS z_vol,
    IF(taa_act IS NOT NULL AND taa_esp IS NOT NULL AND act_t > 0,
       ((taa_act - taa_esp) / 100) / sqrt(LEAST(GREATEST(taa_esp / 100, 0.005), 0.995) * (1 - LEAST(GREATEST(taa_esp / 100, 0.005), 0.995)) / act_t)) AS z_taa,
    act_d - act_t * (1 - taa_esp / 100) AS exc_t,
    act_d - esp_d AS exc_d, act_d / GREATEST(esp_d, 1) AS x_d, (act_d - esp_d) / sqrt(2 * GREATEST(esp_d, 1)) AS z_d,
    act_r - esp_r AS exc_r, act_r / GREATEST(esp_r, 1) AS x_r, (act_r - esp_r) / sqrt(2 * GREATEST(esp_r, 1)) AS z_r
  FROM ez2),
ez4 AS (SELECT ez3.*,
    (z_vol IS NULL OR z_vol <= -2) AS sig_baja,
    (z_taa IS NULL OR z_taa <= -2) AS sig_taa,
    (z_vol IS NULL OR z_vol >= 2) AS sig_suba,
    COALESCE(exc_d >= min_exc AND z_d >= 3, false) AS den_real,
    COALESCE(exc_r >= min_rev AND z_r >= 3, false) AS rev_real
  FROM ez3),
ez5 AS (SELECT ez4.*,
    COALESCE(dvol <= -60 AND sig_baja, false) AS bv1, COALESCE(dvol <= -30 AND sig_baja, false) AS bv0,
    COALESCE(dtaa <= -4 AND sig_taa AND exc_t >= min_exc, false) AS bt1,
    COALESCE(dtaa <= -1.5 AND sig_taa AND exc_t >= min_exc, false) AS bt0,
    COALESCE(den_real AND x_d >= 4, false) AS bd1, COALESCE(den_real AND x_d >= 2, false) AS bd0,
    COALESCE(rev_real AND x_r >= 6, false) AS br1, COALESCE(rev_real AND x_r >= 3, false) AS br0
  FROM ez4),
ez6 AS (SELECT ez5.*,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(esp_t < 50, true) AND act_t < 50 THEN 'nd'
         WHEN esp_t IS NULL OR esp_t = 0 THEN IF(act_t >= 50, 'info', 'nd')
         WHEN bv1 OR bt1 OR bd1 OR br1 THEN 'crit'
         WHEN bv0 OR bt0 OR bd0 OR br0 THEN 'warn'
         WHEN dvol >= 30 AND sig_suba THEN 'info'
         ELSE 'ok' END AS st0
  FROM ez5),
ez7 AS (SELECT ez6.*,
    -- un segmento chico que deja de operar: se mira en 30'
    COALESCE(st0 = 'nd' AND esp_30 >= 8
             AND (act30 = 0 OR (act30 <= esp_30 / 3 AND (act30 - esp_30) / sqrt(esp_30) <= -3)), false) AS chica,
    IF(st0 = 'crit', bv1, bv0) AS ej_v, IF(st0 = 'crit', bt1 OR bd1, bt0 OR bd0) AS ej_r, IF(st0 = 'crit', br1, br0) AS ej_rv
  FROM ez6),
ez8 AS (SELECT ez7.*,
    CASE WHEN chica THEN IF(act30 = 0, 'crit', 'warn') ELSE st0 END AS st,
    CASE WHEN chica THEN 'volumen'
         WHEN st0 NOT IN ('crit', 'warn') THEN NULL
         WHEN ej_v AND NOT ej_r THEN 'volumen'
         WHEN ej_r AND NOT ej_v THEN 'rechazo'
         WHEN ej_v AND ej_r THEN IF(dvol <= -60, 'volumen', 'rechazo')
         WHEN ej_rv THEN 'reversos'
         ELSE 'rechazo' END AS causa,
    IF(chica, 100.0 * act30 / esp_30 - 100, dvol) AS dvol_v
  FROM ez7),
est AS (SELECT ez8.*,
    CASE WHEN st IN ('nd', 'ok', 'info') THEN st
         WHEN causa = 'rechazo' THEN 'rech' WHEN causa = 'reversos' THEN 'rev'
         WHEN (chica AND act30 = 0) OR (NOT chica AND act_t = 0) THEN 'cero' ELSE 'vol' END AS tipo,
    CASE WHEN st = 'nd' AND NOT chica THEN 'nd' WHEN chica THEN st WHEN bv1 THEN 'crit' WHEN bv0 THEN 'warn'
         WHEN COALESCE(esp_t > 0 AND dvol >= 30 AND sig_suba, false) OR ((esp_t IS NULL OR esp_t = 0) AND act_t >= 50) THEN 'info'
         ELSE 'ok' END AS sev_vol,
    CASE WHEN st = 'nd' THEN 'nd' WHEN bt1 THEN 'crit' WHEN bt0 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END AS sev_taa,
    CASE WHEN st = 'nd' THEN 'nd' WHEN bd1 THEN 'crit' WHEN bd0 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END AS sev_den,
    CASE WHEN st = 'nd' THEN 'nd' WHEN br1 THEN 'crit' WHEN br0 THEN 'warn' ELSE 'ok' END AS sev_rev
  FROM ez8)
SELECT COALESCE(gm_.nombre, CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.gw,'')='' THEN 'Sin plataforma' ELSE 'No mapeado' END) || ' (' || COALESCE(NULLIF(e.gw,''),'-') || ')' AS "Gateway",
  ((CASE e.st WHEN 'crit' THEN 'C' WHEN 'warn' THEN 'W' WHEN 'info' THEN 'I' WHEN 'ok' THEN 'N' WHEN 'nd' THEN 'D' ELSE 'D' END) || '|' || (CASE e.tipo WHEN 'rech' THEN '✖ Más rechazos' WHEN 'rev' THEN '↺ Más reversos' WHEN 'vol' THEN '▼ Menos tráfico' WHEN 'cero' THEN '▼ Sin tráfico' WHEN 'info' THEN '▲ Más tráfico' WHEN 'ok' THEN '✔ En banda' WHEN 'nd' THEN '○ Sin evaluar' END)) AS "Estado",
  ROUND(1.0 * e.act_t / e.vent, 1) AS "TRX/min",
  ROUND(e.esp_t / e.vent, 1) AS "Habitual/min",
  ROUND(e.dvol_v, 0) AS "Δ vol %",
  ROUND(e.z_vol, 1) AS "z vol",
  ROUND(e.taa_act, 2) AS "Acept.",
  ROUND(e.taa_esp, 2) AS "Acept. hab.",
  ROUND(e.dtaa, 1) AS "Δ acept. pp",
  ROUND(e.x_d, 1) AS "Deneg. ×",
  ROUND(e.x_r, 1) AS "Revers. ×",
  date_format(e.lt - INTERVAL '3' HOUR, '%H:%i') AS "Último tráfico",
  date_diff('minute', e.lt, l.m - INTERVAL '1' MINUTE) AS "Silencio (min)",
  e.gw AS cod
FROM est e CROSS JOIN lim2 l
LEFT JOIN gwmap gm_ ON gm_.cod = e.gw
WHERE e.act_t + COALESCE(e.esp_t, 0) >= e.vent OR e.st IN ('crit', 'warn')
ORDER BY CASE e.st WHEN 'crit' THEN 0 WHEN 'warn' THEN 1 WHEN 'info' THEN 2 WHEN 'ok' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
  CASE e.causa WHEN 'rechazo' THEN e.exc_d WHEN 'reversos' THEN e.exc_r
       WHEN 'volumen' THEN COALESCE(e.esp_t, 0) - e.act_t ELSE COALESCE(e.esp_t, e.act_t) END DESC

WITH b AS (SELECT a.minuto_utc AS ts,TRIM(a.cod_respuesta) AS cr,TRIM(a.cod_tipo_mensaje) AS cmsg,NULLIF(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),'') AS ciss,NULLIF(TRIM(a.nrorechazointerno),'') AS nri,CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'PN' THEN 'NARANJA' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('PB','PC','PM','PP') THEN 'PRIVADAS' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.marca),''), 'OTRAS') END AS marca_f,TRIM(a.codbancoemisor) AS cbe_f,CASE WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))=1 THEN '0'||TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss) WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))>=2 THEN substr(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))-1,2) ELSE NULL END AS ciss_norm FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(e.cod_debito_automatico_estab,'')) = '1') dafil ON dafil.nro_establecimiento = TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento) AS INTEGER) WHERE a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeFrom()),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeTo()),'%Y-%m-%d') AND TRIM(a.cod_proceso_autorizacion) NOT IN('92','30') AND TRIM(a.cod_tipo_mensaje)<>'1420' AND (COALESCE(NULLIF('${cuit:raw}',''),'-1')='-1' OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT)=TRY_CAST(REPLACE('${cuit:raw}','-','') AS BIGINT)) AND ('${establecimiento:raw}'='' OR TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento)='${establecimiento:raw}')
    AND (TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) NOT IN (30712334610,30715313681,30717791904,30718438906,30716325586,30691399768,33714595569,30709228419))
    -- FILTRO Tipo de producto
    AND ( '${producto:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('VD','MD','MS') THEN 'Débito' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('V6','VB','VN','VC','MC','AX','PA') THEN 'Crédito' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('VK','SR','MK') THEN 'Prepaga' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('PB','PC','PM','PP') THEN 'Marcas Privadas' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'PN' THEN 'Naranja Pura' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'UC' THEN 'Indeterminado (Créd/Déb)' ELSE 'Otro' END) = '${producto:raw}' )
    -- FILTRO Plataforma de pago (la variable trae el sufijo de 4 digitos)
    AND ( '${plataforma:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR contains(split('${plataforma:raw}', ','),
                      IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4,
                         substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4),
                         TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,'')))) )
    -- FILTRO Modalidad
    AND ( '${modalidad:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.coddebitoautomatico,'')) = '1'
                     OR ( dafil.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL
                          AND TRIM(COALESCE(a.codmetodoingresomovimiento,'')) IN ('0','1') )
                        THEN 'Débito Automático'

panels.title: TAA actual vs habitual + Volumen Total/Aprobadas/Denegadas · ${resolucion:text}
panels.description: Habitual = mediana del mismo bucket en D-7 · D-14 · D-21 sin feriados (la TAA de un día cuenta si tiene al menos 5 tx en el bucket). Total TRX = Aprobadas + Denegadas del bucket (sin reversos).

TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'PN' THEN 'NARANJA' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('PB','PC','PM','PP') THEN 'PRIVADAS' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.marca),''), 'OTRAS') END AS marca_f, -4), TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) AS gw, a.latencia_ms AS lat FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.nro_establecimiento FROM -336, $__timeFrom()) AND a.minuto_utc < date_add('hour', -336, $__timeTo())) OR (a.minuto_utc >= date_add('hour', -504, $__timeFrom()) AND a.minuto_utc < date_add('hour', -504, $__timeTo()))) AND     AND ( '${plataforma:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR contains(split('${plataforma:raw}', ','),
                      IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4,
                         substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4),
                         TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,'')))) )
    -- FILTRO Modalidad
    AND ( '${modalidad:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.coddebitoautomatico,'')) = '1'
                     OR ( dafil.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL
                          AND TRIM(COALESCE(a.codmetodoingresomovimiento,'')) IN ('0','1') )

                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) = '8'
                        THEN 'E-commerce'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) <> ''
                        THEN 'Presente'
                   ELSE 'Indeterminado'
              END) = '${modalidad:raw}' )),
filt AS (SELECT * FROM b WHERE 1=1 AND ('${marca:text}'='All' OR marca_f IN (${marca:sqlstring})) AND ('${banco:text}'='All' OR cbe_f IN (${banco:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_emisor:text}'='All' OR ciss_norm IN (${motivo_emisor:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_adqte:text}'='All' OR nri IN (${motivo_adqte:sqlstring}))),

  WHERE cmsg<>'1420') WHERE ep IS NOT NULL),

WITH agg AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('minute',a.minuto_utc)-(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM a.minuto_utc)%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE AS bk,
    SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(a.cod_respuesta) IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aprob,
    SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(a.cod_respuesta) NOT IN('0000','0400','0900') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deneg,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM payway_poststage_prod_db.abt0_ctx_livemonitoring a LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.nro_establecimiento FROM prisma_ab_analytics_prod_db.establecimiento e WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(e.cod_debito_automatico_estab,'')) = '1') dafil ON dafil.nro_establecimiento = TRY_CAST(TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento) AS INTEGER)
  WHERE a.fecha_particion BETWEEN date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeFrom()),'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(date_add('hour',-3,$__timeTo()),'%Y-%m-%d')
    AND a.minuto_utc>=$__timeFrom() AND a.minuto_utc<$__timeTo()
    AND TRIM(a.cod_proceso_autorizacion) NOT IN('92','30')
    AND TRIM(a.cod_tipo_mensaje)<>'1420'
    AND (CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('VD','MD','MS') THEN 'Débito' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('V6','VB','VN','VC','MC','AX','PA') THEN 'Crédito' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('VK','SR','MK') THEN 'Prepaga' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('PB','PC','PM','PP') THEN 'Marcas Privadas' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'PN' THEN 'Naranja Pura' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'UC' THEN 'Indeterminado (Créd/Déb)' ELSE 'Otro' END) = 'Prepaga' AND (COALESCE(NULLIF('${cuit:raw}',''),'-1')='-1' OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT)=TRY_CAST(REPLACE('${cuit:raw}','-','') AS BIGINT)) AND ('${establecimiento:raw}'='' OR TRIM(a.nro_establecimiento)='${establecimiento:raw}')
    AND (TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(REPLACE(a.cuit,'-','') AS BIGINT) NOT IN (30712334610,30715313681,30717791904,30718438906,30716325586,30691399768,33714595569,30709228419))
    -- FILTRO Tipo de producto
    AND ( '${producto:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('VD','MD','MS') THEN 'Débito' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('V6','VB','VN','VC','MC','AX','PA') THEN 'Crédito' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('VK','SR','MK') THEN 'Prepaga' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('PB','PC','PM','PP') THEN 'Marcas Privadas' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'PN' THEN 'Naranja Pura' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'UC' THEN 'Indeterminado (Créd/Déb)' ELSE 'Otro' END) = '${producto:raw}' )
    -- FILTRO Plataforma de pago (la variable trae el sufijo de 4 digitos)
    AND ( '${plataforma:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR contains(split('${plataforma:raw}', ','),
                      IF(length(TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,''))) >= 4,
                         substr(TRIM(a.programaperiferiaorigen), -4),
                         TRIM(COALESCE(a.programaperiferiaorigen,'')))) )
    -- FILTRO Modalidad
    AND ( '${modalidad:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')
          OR (CASE
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.coddebitoautomatico,'')) = '1'
                     OR ( dafil.nro_establecimiento IS NOT NULL
                          AND TRIM(COALESCE(a.codmetodoingresomovimiento,'')) IN ('0','1') )
                        THEN 'Débito Automático'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) = '8'
                        THEN 'E-commerce'
                   WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.codidentpresenciacliente,'')) <> ''
                        THEN 'Presente'
                   ELSE 'Indeterminado'
              END) = '${modalidad:raw}' ) AND ('${marca:text}'='All' OR (CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) = 'PN' THEN 'NARANJA' WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(a.instrmtyp,'')) IN ('PB','PC','PM','PP') THEN 'PRIVADAS' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.marca),''), 'OTRAS') END) IN (${marca:sqlstring})) AND ('${banco:text}'='All' OR TRIM(a.codbancoemisor) IN (${banco:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_emisor:text}'='All' OR (CASE WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))=1 THEN '0'||TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss) WHEN length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))>=2 THEN substr(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss),length(TRIM(a.codrespuestaiss))-1,2) ELSE NULL END) IN (${motivo_emisor:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_adqte:text}'='All' OR NULLIF(TRIM(a.nrorechazointerno),'') IN (${motivo_adqte:sqlstring}))
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT bk AS time,
  ROUND(100.0*aprob/NULLIF(total,0),2) AS "TAA Prepaga",
  aprob AS "Aprobadas",
  deneg AS "Denegadas"
FROM agg ORDER BY 1;

    AND TRIM(a.cod_proceso_autorizacion) NOT IN('92','30')

    AND ( '${modalidad:raw}' IN ('-1','','$__all')

              END) = '${modalidad:raw}' )
),
filt AS (SELECT * FROM b WHERE 1=1 AND ('${marca:text}'='All' OR marca_f IN (${marca:sqlstring})) AND ('${banco:text}'='All' OR cbe_f IN (${banco:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_emisor:text}'='All' OR ciss_norm IN (${motivo_emisor:sqlstring})) AND ('${motivo_adqte:text}'='All' OR nri IN (${motivo_adqte:sqlstring}))),
denegados AS (
  SELECT ts, bin8 FROM filt 
  WHERE ts>=$__timeFrom() AND ts<$__timeTo() 
    AND cmsg<>'1420' AND cr NOT IN('0000','0400','0900') 
    AND bin8 IS NOT NULL AND bin8<>''
),
top10 AS (SELECT bin8, COUNT(*) AS n FROM denegados GROUP BY bin8 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT date_trunc('minute',d.ts)-(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM d.ts)%(CASE WHEN ${resolucion:raw} > 0 THEN ${resolucion:raw} WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 180 THEN 1 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 720 THEN 5 WHEN date_diff('minute',$__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) <= 2880 THEN 15 ELSE 60 END))*INTERVAL '1' MINUTE AS time,
  d.bin8 AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS rechazos
FROM denegados d JOIN top10 t ON d.bin8=t.bin8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;
